{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Spectator''' was a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy that appeared in [[The Narratorium]] as a part of [[The Final Act Event]]. It was a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy that had a decent amount of health and slightly fast speed. ==Logbook Description== "''Righty finds the Spectators unsettling because when they were possessed by the Narrator, their bodies transformed into coal-black silhouettes. These ghostly figures haunt the theater's darkest corners, watching performances from the shadows while avoiding contact with anyone else.''" ==Appearance== The '''Spectator''' takes on the appearance of a seemingly aristocratic show viewer, wearing a comedy mask and binoculars and a top hat. But by default, the '''Spectator''' is [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]], making it hard to make out during gameplay. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers with hidden detection, like the [[Turret]], [[Accelerator]], [[Warlock]], bottom path [[Pursuit]] or [[Golden Minigunner]] are recommended to take this down. **Towers which normally do not have it, like the [[Ranger]] or top path [[Pursuit]] can still be used, however they need to be able to see them with the help of another tower, like the [[Ace Pilot]] or [[Spotlight Tech]]. *As the '''Spectator''' is quite fast, stalling towers with hidden detection, like the [[Freezer]], or towers which can consistently hit them without it, like the [[DJ Booth]], can be very useful. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} SpectatorWalk.gif|Walking animation (20 December 2025 – Present) SpectatorStun.gif|Stun animation (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseSpectator.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} TheFinalActPI3.png|'''Spectator''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} SpectatorIconIG.png|'''Spectator''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Spectator''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]]a **'''Spectator''' added. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''Spectator''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{TheNarratorium|[[Exo Follower]] & [[Exo Guard]]|Wave 10|Spectator|Wave 12|[[Stunt Man]]|Wave 14}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
